description: The stages one thing moves through, in order and joined by a line: an order shipped, a release train, a case history. A row is a milestone with a title, a time and a meaning; it is not an event someone performed, which is ArenaActivityFeed. Nothing in it is operated.

label.description: Names the list: what this is the history or the progress of, such as Order 4821, never Timeline. Required, and guarded at runtime after trimming: nothing can derive it.

items.description: The milestones, in the order they are drawn. Arena draws each row from its fields; an empty list draws nothing.

index.description: Which milestone is current, counted from zero, for a timeline still in motion. The milestones before it are complete and the ones after it upcoming. Absent, or at or past the end, every milestone is complete, which is a history. A negative or non-finite value reads as 0.
